conclusion: The original Orca integration and earlier large-project benchmarks remain historical at their own anchors. Current verification additionally covers manufacturable organic interface roads and first-layer full-width route splicing while preserving raw tree/model generation, existing Brim and actual 0.17 mm bottom contacts. This local source-bound verification does not establish a new upstream merge, current remote state, GUI interaction result or a new large-project speed benchmark.
scope: Reviewed native interface manufacturing and test2 Release output as of 2026-10-26; older evidence retains its original anchors.
